default.notes: Apply online for the official Benin e-Visa (evisa.bj) before travel — 30- and 90-day options; there is no visa on arrival.

groups.notes: ECOWAS citizens enter freely under the Community's free-movement protocol — up to 90 days with a valid passport or ECOWAS travel document.
Benin waived visas for citizens of all African countries — entry is visa-free for short stays, commonly up to 90 days; confirm the stamped duration on arrival.

BJ.notes: Home country — no entry requirements for Beninese citizens.
